question: Under the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana, how many Jan Aushadhi Kendras (JAKs) have been opened till 28 February 2025 across India, having an end-to-end IT-enabled supply chain system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15,057**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)** has achieved a significant milestone by opening **15,057** **Jan Aushadhi Kendras (JAKs)** across the country as of **28 February 2025**.
 
• This scheme is a flagship initiative of the **Department of Pharmaceuticals**, **Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers**, Government of India, aimed at providing quality generic medicines at affordable prices.
 
• The **Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)** is the implementing agency that oversees the establishment and operations of these kendras.
 
• The network utilizes an **end-to-end IT-enabled supply chain system**, which includes a centralized **Warehouse Management System (WMS)** and **SAP-based inventory tracking** to ensure the timely availability of medicines.
 
• By **February 2025**, the coverage of the scheme has expanded to almost every district in **India**, significantly reducing the out-of-pocket expenditure on healthcare for the common man.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Product Basket:** The PMBJP product basket has grown extensively and currently includes more than **2,000 medicines** and over **300 surgical devices**, covering all major therapeutic groups such as anti-diabetics, cardiovascular drugs, and antibiotics.
 
• **Pricing Structure:** Medicines sold at **Jan Aushadhi Kendras** are priced **50% to 90%** lower than the market prices of branded medicines, ensuring that "quality medicine is not a luxury."
 
• **Jan Aushadhi Sugam Mobile App:** The government launched a digital tool to help citizens locate the nearest **Jan Aushadhi Kendra**, check medicine availability, and compare prices of generic versus branded medicines.
 
• **Employment and Incentives:** The scheme encourages **entrepreneurship** among pharmacists and NGOs. Individual entrepreneurs are provided an incentive of up to **Rs. 5 lakhs**, and special incentives of **Rs. 2 lakhs** are given for kendras opened in **North-Eastern states**, **Himalayan areas**, and **Aspirational Districts**.
 
• **Quality Assurance:** Every batch of medicine supplied to these kendras is tested at **NABL-accredited laboratories** to ensure they meet the highest standards of safety and efficacy before reaching the public.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Historical Context:** Originally launched as the **Jan Aushadhi Scheme** in **2008**, it was later revamped and renamed as **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)** in **2015-16** to give it more momentum and wider reach.
 
• **Supply Chain Infrastructure:** To support the **15,057** centers, the **PMBI** operates a large-scale logistics network consisting of **central warehouses** and several **regional warehouses** strategically located across different **states**.
 
• **Social Impact:** In the last few years, the scheme has saved citizens billions of rupees. For example, in the **financial year 2023-24** alone, the scheme helped consumers save approximately **Rs. 10,000 crore**.
 
• **Menstrual Hygiene:** Under the scheme, **Suvidha Oxo-biodegradable Sanitary Napkins** are sold at a nominal price of **Re. 1 per pad** to improve menstrual health among women in rural and urban areas.
